name: Bing Chilling
blurb: John Cena saying "ice cream" (冰淇淋 bīngqílín) in Mandarin, misheard as "bing chilling"
aka: 早上好中国 现在我有冰淇淋
title: Bing Chilling Meaning: John Cena's Ice Cream Meme Explained
description: "Bing chilling" is how English speakers hear 冰淇淋 (bīngqílín), Mandarin for ice cream, from a 2021 video of John Cena eating ice cream and speaking Chinese.
answer: "Bing chilling" is an English-ear spelling of 冰淇淋 (bīngqílín), the Mandarin word for ice cream. It comes from a video John Cena posted on Weibo on 10 May 2021 to promote Fast & Furious 9, in which he sits in a car holding an ice cream cone and says in Mandarin, roughly, "Good morning China, now I have ice cream." Reposts and remixes made it a YouTube meme in 2021, and in late 2022 it became a TikTok trend of people reciting the whole speech.

body: Cena, who studies Mandarin, speaks to camera in Chinese with subtitles: good morning China, now I have ice cream, I like ice cream very much, but Fast & Furious 9 is even better than ice cream. Between lines he sings into the cone as if it were a microphone. The cheerful delivery, the ice cream and the word bīngqílín, which sounds like "bing chilling" to English speakers, are the whole joke.

body.note: In Chinese the opening is 「早上好中国，现在我有冰淇淋」(zǎoshang hǎo Zhōngguó, xiànzài wǒ yǒu bīngqílín). Cena never commented on the meme officially.

head: Date
Event
rows: Cena posts the promo video on his Weibo account.
YouTubers repost it; "John Cena eats Bing Chilling in 1080p" (28 June) and subtitle-parody edits get millions of views.
Remixes add sound effects every time he says the word; "bing chilling" becomes the meme's name.
A TikTok trend starts: people perform the speech in Mandarin, copying Cena's pronunciation; one clip passes 13 million plays.

ul: Eating ice cream: "Bing chilling 🍦" as a caption.
Saying the opening line as a greeting: "Zǎoshang hǎo Zhōngguó!"
Language-learning jokes: "Day 1 of Mandarin: I can say bing chilling."
Lip-syncing the full speech, cone in hand, on TikTok.

body: Bing Chilling peaked in 2021–2022 and is now a well-known classic. It still pops up whenever someone eats ice cream on camera or shows off beginner Mandarin, and it sits alongside other TikTok-era classics such as the Grimace Shake and Chill Guy. It is best used as light, friendly fun about language learning, not to mock how anyone speaks.

faq.a: 冰淇淋 (bīngqílín), the Mandarin word for ice cream.

faq.q: What is John Cena saying in the bing chilling video?
faq.a: Roughly: "Good morning China. Now I have ice cream. I really like ice cream, but Fast & Furious 9 is better than ice cream."

faq.q: When was the bing chilling video posted?
faq.a: On 10 May 2021, on Cena's Weibo account, as a promo for Fast & Furious 9.
